_readme: Projects that open in place from the home wall (a tile with data-project=<slug>). Source of truth for tools/build_projects.py, which builds media/projects/<slug>/ and writes one <template data-proj> per project into index.html. Monitor 1 is on program when the project opens; type loop = the wall's own loop (media/loops). Paths: PV/ = Desktop/Production Visuals, S/ = this repo.

projects.title: STRUJA
projects.line: A festival identity that is a behaviour, not a file: one line of light on the river, drawn by the music, cutting through the name.
projects.idea: One line of sodium streetlight on the Sava. At rest it is the river’s real course through Belgrade; the music bends it, every kick sends a wave downstream, and at the drop the line unwinds. One custom WebGL engine draws it from the track, and the same engine rendered the film, the posters and every screen.
projects.role: Concept, identity, motion, original score, creative code, front-end
facts: The line’s rest shape, from map data
projects.note: STRUJA is a fictional festival and a self-initiated project. Water footage and mockups: Freepik (licensed). Stage plates: Midjourney. River data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Typeface: Science Gothic (SIL OFL).
